title: Auto-Reply
reply.default: I'm away right now and will reply as soon as I can.
settings.enabled.about: People who write to you in private chats get the text below.
settings.enabled.until: On, turns off by itself at {1}.
settings.text.about: {name} is replaced with the first name of the person.
settings.reply_to.about: The answer quotes the message it answers.
settings.off_on_send.about: Any message you send from this computer turns it off. Messages from the phone do not.

settings.repeat.about.one: One person gets the answer at most once in {1} minute.
settings.repeat.about.other: One person gets the answer at most once in {1} minutes.

settings.quiet.about.one: After you write to a chat yourself, it keeps quiet there for {1} minute.
settings.quiet.about.other: After you write to a chat yourself, it keeps quiet there for {1} minutes.

settings.commands.about: “/away text” turns it on with a new text, “/away 2h text” also turns it off in 2 hours (m, h, d work too), “/back” turns it off. The commands are not sent.
settings.who: Bots, groups, channels, Telegram's service notices and you yourself never get an answer.
log.title: Who wrote
log.about: Click a name to open the chat. The list starts over every time the auto-reply turns on.
